title: Critic-V: VLM Critics Help Catch VLM Errors in Multimodal Reasoning
authors_zh: Di Zhang、Jingdi Lei、Junxian Li、Xunzhi Wang、Yujie Liu、Zonglin Yang、Jiatong Li、Weida Wang、Suorong Yang、Jianbo Wu、Peng Ye、Wanli Ouyang、Dongzhan Zhou
paper_type_zh: 多模态 critic 偏好数据与 DPO 方法
best_for_zh: 需要训练视觉语言 critic、自然语言反馈或多模态推理纠错模型的研究者
one_line: Critic-V releases 29,012 multimodal critique preference pairs and trains a DPO critic that gives natural-language feedback to refine VLM reasoning.
发布按规则奖励排序的多模态批评偏好数据，用自然语言 critique 修正视觉推理路径，可直接训练 critic 与策略模型。
why: It replaces a scalar reward with preference-optimized textual critiques that can identify and guide correction of a reasoning error.
inclusion_reason: Critic-V provides a public multimodal critique-preference corpus and associated code for critic training.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Multimodal models hallucinate visual content or follow flawed reasoning paths, while a final correct/incorrect scalar does not indicate what to revise. Asking the same model to self-criticize can favor its own answer, and high-quality data distinguishing useful from unhelpful critiques is scarce.

Critic-V separates a Reasoner from a Critic. The Reasoner generates multimodal reasoning, while the Critic provides natural-language revision feedback. The Critic is trained with DPO on critique preferences ranked by rule-based reward, and its feedback iteratively updates the Reasoner’s textual policy.

多模态模型在复杂视觉推理中会产生幻觉或走错推理路径，只有最终正确/错误标量无法告诉模型哪里需要修改；直接让同一模型自我批评又常偏爱自身答案，缺少高质量、能区分批评优劣的训练反馈。

Critic-V 将 Reasoner 与 Critic 解耦：Reasoner 生成多模态推理，Critic 给出自然语言修改意见；Critic 用按规则奖励排序的 critique preference data 做 DPO，之后反馈迭代更新 Reasoner 的文本策略。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Critic-V separates a Reasoner from a Critic. The Reasoner generates multimodal reasoning, while the Critic provides natural-language revision feedback. The Critic is trained with DPO on critique preferences ranked by rule-based reward, and its feedback iteratively updates the Reasoner’s textual policy. The official repository releases Critic-V training and evaluation assets. The core preference object combines an image, question, original reasoning response, two candidate critiques, and a chosen/rejected ranking produced by rule-based reward. The paper does not present it as a large general dataset with a standalone data card and stable count, so reuse should follow the repository version actually used.

Critic-V 将 Reasoner 与 Critic 解耦：Reasoner 生成多模态推理，Critic 给出自然语言修改意见；Critic 用按规则奖励排序的 critique preference data 做 DPO，之后反馈迭代更新 Reasoner 的文本策略。官方仓库发布 Critic-V 的训练与评测资产，其中核心偏好对象是图像、问题、原推理回答、两条候选 critique 及基于规则奖励形成的 chosen/rejected 排序。论文未把它包装为一个具有独立数据卡和稳定样本数的大型通用数据集，复用时应以仓库实际文件版本为准。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Have the Reasoner generate a full reasoning path and answer from an image and question.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Generate multiple critiques for the same reasoning, asking them to identify visual or logical errors and provide actionable revisions.
  1. Verify and filter: Use rule-based reward to rank whether critiques detect errors and improve correction, form preference pairs, and train an independent Critic with DPO.
  1. Train and evaluate: At inference, the Critic returns natural-language feedback and the Reasoner iteratively rewrites; actor–critic optimization is secondary to the data construction here.

1. 建立数据源： 让 Reasoner 针对图像和问题生成推理路径及答案，保留可供批评的完整文本。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 为同一推理生成多条 critique，要求指出视觉理解或逻辑步骤问题并给出可执行修改建议。
  1. 验证与筛选： 用规则奖励比较 critique 是否识别错误、是否促进修正，形成偏好对，再以 DPO 训练独立 Critic。
  1. 训练与评测： 推理时 Critic 返回自然语言反馈，Reasoner 根据反馈迭代重写；训练和评测只简要使用 actor-critic 目标。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Critic-V outperforms GPT-4V on five of eight multimodal benchmarks, particularly in reasoning accuracy and efficiency. Ablations degrade when the Critic lacks preference optimization or uses only scalar feedback, supporting the importance of ranking natural-language critique quality rather than merely adding another model call. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.
Critic-V 在 8 个多模态 benchmark 中有 5 个超过 GPT-4V，尤其改善推理准确率与效率；消融显示没有偏好优化的 Critic 或只使用标量反馈时效果下降，支持“自然语言 critique 的质量排序”是关键，而不仅是增加一次模型调用。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior multimodal self-reflection often uses one model to generate, score, and revise. Critic-V trains an independent Critic and changes the supervised object from answer preference to which critique better repairs reasoning, using rule-based reward to form critique-level DPO data.
已有多模态自反思通常让一个模型生成、评分和修订；Critic-V 的变化是独立训练 Critic，并把监督对象从答案偏好转为“哪条批评更能修正推理”，用规则奖励建立 critique-level DPO 数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Rule-based reward determines critique ranking; if it mainly checks final answers, it may prefer post-hoc rationalization over true first-error localization.
  1. Feedback risk: Critic and Reasoner may share model-family and data biases, so iterative feedback can still amplify hallucinations.
  1. Reproduction and use: Dataset scale, licence, and exact filtering are less explicit than in a standalone data card; file lineage should be audited before reuse.

1. 覆盖边界： 规则奖励决定 critique 排序，若规则只检查最终答案，可能偏好事后合理化而非真实定位首错。
  1. 反馈风险： Critic 与 Reasoner 的模型家族和数据分布可能共享偏差，迭代反馈仍可能放大幻觉。
  1. 复现与使用： 公开仓库的数据规模、许可和精确过滤过程不如独立 dataset card 清晰，复用前需审计文件 lineage。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Train a multimodal critic to output actionable natural-language feedback rather than only a score.
  1. Training: Use critique preferences for DPO and validate on an independent human error-localization set.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Build iterative Reasoner–Critic inference, but do not treat critique rankings as true process supervision without reliable rules or human verification.

1. 评测： 训练多模态 critic 输出可操作自然语言反馈，而非仅返回分数。
  1. 训练： 把 critique preference 数据用于 DPO，并在独立人工错误定位集上验证。
  1. 迁移或部署： 构建 Reasoner–Critic 迭代推理；若没有可靠规则或人工验证，不能把 critique 排名当作真实过程监督。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: Critic-V separates a Reasoner from a Critic.
  1. Method takeaway: Generate multiple critiques for the same reasoning, asking them to identify visual or logical errors and provide actionable revisions. Use rule-based reward to rank whether critiques detect errors and improve correction, form preference pairs, and train an independent Critic with DPO.
  1. Data takeaway: The official repository releases Critic-V training and evaluation assets.
  1. Evidence anchor: Critic-V outperforms GPT-4V on five of eight multimodal benchmarks, particularly in reasoning accuracy and efficiency.
  1. Reuse decision: Train a multimodal critic to output actionable natural-language feedback rather than only a score. The main risk is that rule-based reward determines critique ranking; if it mainly checks final answers, it may prefer post-hoc rationalization over true first-error localization.

1. 一句话定位： Critic-V 将 Reasoner 与 Critic 解耦。
  1. 方法抓手： 为同一推理生成多条 critique。用规则奖励比较 critique 是否识别错误、是否促进修正。
  1. 数据抓手： 官方仓库发布 Critic-V 的训练与评测资产。
  1. 证据锚点： Critic-V 在 8 个多模态 benchmark 中有 5 个超过 GPT-4V。
  1. 复用决定： 训练多模态 critic 输出可操作自然语言反馈。最大风险是规则奖励决定 critique 排序。
